name: City Greens Golf
address: The Red Building, Old Bank of England Court, Queen Street, Norwich NR2 4SX

booking.howItWorks: Events: build an instant quote online and send it; the team replies within one working day with availability and the final price. A 50% deposit secures the date. Rooms: book online up to 7 days ahead, from 12pm each day.

packages.name: Private TrackMan room
packages.description: Your own private TrackMan IO simulator room for up to 4 players, clubs included. You pay for the room; price depends on number of players, length and time (Off-Peak Mon–Fri 12pm–5pm, Peak evenings, weekends and bank holidays, Super Peak Fri & Sat 5pm–11pm). From £25 an hour inc. VAT. Visitors book from 12pm, up to 7 days ahead.

packages.name: Private event / party (2 hours of golf)
packages.description: Team socials, client entertaining, birthdays and Christmas parties for 4–24 guests. Up to 12 play at once across three rooms; groups up to 24 rotate between rooms and the lounge. Three hours recommended for groups over 12 (+£180 for the group). Prices include VAT.
includes: Use of the bar and lounge

addOns.name: Third hour of golf
addOns.description: Extra hour for the whole group; recommended for groups over 12

faq.q: Do I need to be a member to play?
faq.a: No. Our rooms are open to pay-as-you-go visitors from 12pm every day, bookable up to 7 days ahead. 8am–12pm is members only.

faq.q: How many people can book a room?
faq.a: Each room comfortably fits up to four players. Larger groups can book rooms side by side, subject to availability.

faq.q: Do I need my own clubs or shoes?
faq.a: No. Clubs are included for everyone, with left-handed, women's and junior sets on request, first come, first served. Any clean, flat shoes are fine, including trainers. No golf spikes, please.
Absolutely. Our team will help you get started, and there are relaxed mini-games for non-golfers too. No golf experience needed for events.
Yes. Children aged 14 and under play with an adult in the room. Juniors aged 15–17 can play without an adult in the room under the conditions in our Under-18 policy.

faq.q: Can I get food and drink?
faq.a: Yes. Our bar and lounge serve a curated selection of local food and drinks. For events, add drinks packages, nibbles, snacks, sharing tapas or pizza; menus and dietary requirements are confirmed before booking.
St Andrew's and Monastery Court car parks are nearby. We're a 3 minute walk from Norwich Cathedral and 10 minutes from the railway station.
Arrive 15 minutes early. Your booking time starts at the scheduled time, not from when you arrive.

faq.q: How many people can attend an event?
faq.a: From 4 to 24 guests. Up to 12 play at once across three rooms, and larger groups rotate between the rooms and the lounge. For groups over 12 we suggest three hours.

faq.q: What if there are fewer than four of us?
faq.a: The quote builder starts at four guests. For two or three people, book a standard session or ask us about a tailored experience.

faq.q: How do event payments and cancellations work?
faq.a: Once availability and price are agreed, a 50% deposit reserves your event and the balance is due 14 days before. Within 14 days of the event, bookings are non-refundable.

faq.q: What is the cancellation policy for room bookings?
faq.a: More than 7 days before: refunded or rescheduled. Between 7 days and 48 hours: refunded to your City Greens balance. Less than 48 hours and no-shows: not refundable.
Yes, room and event prices include VAT. Business Membership prices are shown + VAT.

faq.q: Is the event estimate a confirmed booking?
faq.a: No. The estimate helps you plan. We check the date, confirm the final price and explain how to secure your booking, replying within one working day.
